3) Example: measuring how prompt wording affects a model's refusal behavior (Python + pseudocode)
This example shows how to compare model responses to different phrasings to understand when a model refuses and when it answers—useful for UX and safety testing. It does NOT show how to make the model produce harmful content.

api_key = "YOUR_KEY"

    "Explain how photosynthesis works for a 10-year-old.",

    # benign variants that probe phrasing effects

results = []

        "prompt": p,
        "response_text": response.text,

    print("Response excerpt:", r["response_text"][:200])
    print("---")

- Helps product teams understand which phrasings lead to unhelpful refusals so they can craft better user guidance.
- Enables researchers to document when and why a model refuses, and to responsibly report findings to model maintainers so defenses can be improved.
